backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin inclusion and two public types for render order rules and Genesis Craft preview metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries describing functionality and recent changes across various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes, applying background and text styles across the app.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that sets up the root div and loads the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application container defining project data models, validation, persistence integration, navigation, and global state management.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions using the alert-dialog UI component and confirm store.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying attribution text with a heart icon and link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive navigation header with project context, desktop/mobile menus, and integrated save‑status indicator.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Lightweight hover/focus tooltip component that displays contextual text above its children.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog component explaining how to obtain a Pinata JWT token with step-by-step instructions and warnings.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays a small status label showing saving, saved, or idle states without shifting layout.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Provides lock, unlock, and IPFS upload controls for a project, managing publishing states and progress.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle buttons to switch between compact and grid views in the vault UI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Zustand-powered confirmation modal logic that returns a promise resolved by user confirmation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Debounced validation hook for Pinata JWT tokens with status tracking and abort handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty module indicating no backend queries are used because persistence is client-side.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind styles and custom utilities defining theme variables, motion settings, and UI effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Sets up the React app root with React Query and the InternetIdentity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Provides UI and logic for assembling NFTs, managing trait selection, previews, file uploads, and token deletion.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Displays project listings and handles creating, editing, opening, and deleting NFT projects.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Renders a live preview of layered traits, supports rule‑validated shuffling, and updates project selections.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Allows adjusting trait rarity weights per layer, auto-normalizes values, and updates project data.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of trait compatibility rules within a project.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Handles project settings, including Pinata key validation, metadata format updates, and Solana creator management with validation.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Manages NFT generation view, filtering, sorting, and ZIP creation, and coordinates with a worker for batch generation progress.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Provides UI for managing layers and traits, including adding, deleting, renaming, and updating project layers with rule cleanup.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Uploads NFT images and metadata to Pinata, tracking progress and constructing metadata with IPFS URIs.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Builds metadata objects for preview and export across Solana, Ethereum, and ICP formats, inserting traits and image paths.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Implements atomic project saving/loading to localStorage with legacy cleanup and storage size utilities.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Provides helpers to validate Pinata JWT tokens and upload files, JSON, or directories to IPFS via Pinata APIs.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines typed message protocols, data structures, and type guards for communication between the UI and the NFT generator worker.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Implements a small utility that yields control to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Worker script that generates NFTs by selecting traits, applying rules, ensuring unique DNA, and optionally compositing images with OffscreenCanvas.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, spacing, typography, animations, and content paths for the frontend.
project_state.json: Captures the project's schema version, summary, and a list of existing features with their descriptions and metadata.
